searchModule.name: hybrid 0.12 (text-embedding-3-small, 512 dims, shipped defaults: concept units, tmm, alpha 0.4, minSimilarity 0)

preregistration: Written before the first live run of each step (2026-10-25); dev split only for every choice; held-out and full numbers computed once after the choice and never used to revise it.

Adaptive grid: low in {0.1, 0.2, 0.3} x mid in {0.3, 0.4, 0.5} x high in {0.6, 0.75, 0.9} (high >= mid), concept units, tmm. Choice: best mean of alpinaria-dev and atlas-dev Recall@5; ties within 0.005 by mean nDCG@10, then the smallest low + mid + high.

Adaptive becomes the default only if all four hold: alpinaria synonym Recall@5 >= 0.70; no category worse than its paired bootstrap CI against the fixed 0.4 (rc.2) ranking; overall Recall@5 not below the fixed 0.4 on either fixture; fusion overhead <= 1 ms p95 at 20k vectors.

Units: concepts, sections, contextual-sections, contextual-concepts at the fusion chosen in step 1. Choice: best mean dev Recall@5, ties within 0.005 by mean nDCG@10. The chosen default must not lose to concepts on either fixture beyond the paired CI.

minSimilarity (tau): grid 0..0.8 step 0.005 over the dev splits at the shipped defaults. Constraint: on each fixture's dev split at most 3% of answerable queries have a relevant top-1 and are flagged. Objective: the most no-answer dev queries flagged (pooled). Ties: the smallest tau.

Abstention gate: no-answer recall >= 0.70 on both full fixtures with <= 3% of answerable queries with a relevant top-1 flagged; on the private catalog at least 5 of 7 unanswerable flagged and 0 exact lookups flagged.

grid.rule: best mean dev Recall@5 over the fixtures; ties within 0.005 by mean nDCG@10, then the smallest low + mid + high

gates.gate: no category worse than its paired CI
overall Recall@5 not below fixed 0.4 on either fixture
fusion overhead <= 1 ms p95 at 20k vectors

tokens.$comment: Document prompt tokens to embed both fixtures from scratch (text-embedding-3-small).

abstention.note: Every no-answer query whose top result matches fewer than half of the terms is already an any-term fallback, so the similarity clause (which shares the coverage bound) flags nothing new on the fixtures at any tau up to the first answerable flag; the unflagged no-answer queries all have a top coverage of 0.5 or more.

variantEvidence.$comment: Not shipped; proposal evidence. (mode any && coverage < 0.5) || (mode any && topSimilarity < tau), same tau rule.
variantEvidence.dev: 19 of 24 no-answer queries (alpinaria 11/16, atlas 8/8) with 3/129 and 1/62 relevant top-1 results flagged
